svg.title: pi-path-bar — Minimal mode, built into the borders.
svg.desc: Illustrated Pi terminal in Minimal mode with zero footer rows: top editor border shows a fixed 5-column running spinner, compact usage telemetry, session name, a slot and local time; bottom editor border shows a folder alias, compact Git status, shortened model with thinking level and context gauge. Below: zero-jitter running/idle alignment, narrow-screen degradation with +N folding, and Reading mode plus /path-bar controls. This is a composed UI preview, not a live screenshot.
svg.metadata: Lettering and icons use Maple Mono NF CN. Font and icon attribution: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. No font files or external resources are required in the outlined version.
